name: get_workload_status
description: Summarize a Deployment: desired, ready, updated and available replicas, conditions, current revision, and whether it is managed by GitOps. Read-only.

name: plan_scale_deployment
description: Plan a replica change for a Deployment without changing anything. Runs preflight checks and returns a single-use plan_id, the diff, a measured impact preview (pods added or removed, matching PodDisruptionBudgets and their headroom, ready and projected endpoints of Services selecting the Deployment, and warnings for the approver) and an expiry. The change is only made by apply_scale_deployment with the same arguments and plan_id. Refused when the change is larger than the blast-radius budget allows, would flap the Deployment, exceed its hourly apply budget or plan rate limit, or undo a manual change without override_manual_change.

override_manual_change.description: Default false. Set to true only to change replicas that were changed outside kube-handrail since its last apply; the approver sees it and apply must pass the same value.

name: request_approval
description: Ask the human approvers configured on the server to approve or reject a plan returned by plan_scale_deployment. Approves nothing and changes nothing in the cluster: it marks the plan as awaiting approval, extends its validity for the wait, and notifies the approvers with the plan as recorded by the server. Approvers decide outside MCP; with server approval, the approver's decision also triggers the apply. Repeated calls within a short cooldown notify nobody again, and requests are rate limited.
